subject: MAP kickoff: Acme Labs marketplace private-offer evaluation + billing runway
messages:
From: Sandra Lee <sandra.lee@acmelabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmelabs.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Acme Labs marketplace private-offer evaluation + billing runway

Hi Marissa / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme is keen to move forward with a private offer on AWS and wants a tight evaluation + procurement runbook so our stakeholders (Engineering, Security, and Procurement) know dates and dependencies.

High-level asks from our side:
- A 4-week technical evaluation window (pilot seat + 1M tokens/day simulation)
- SOC 2 evidence and a short security checklist for our security team
- Expected billing path: Marketplace private offer with consolidated billing to our AWS account; how does Redwood bill for token usage and reserved capacity?
- Rough PO timing and any pre-reqs for finance.

Can we get a MAP (mutual action plan) that aligns milestones to these asks? We'd like to kick off next Monday (2026-04-13) if possible.

Thanks,
Sandra Lee
Senior Cloud Procurement Manager
Acme Labs

Attachment: acme-soc2-questions.pdf (7 pages)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Lee <sandra.lee@acmelabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Acme Labs marketplace private-offer evaluation + billing runway

Sandra — great to hear, and absolutely yes on creating a concise MAP. Outline below is my proposed minimal roadmap to get you from pilot -> PO:

1) Week 0 (Prep, target kickoff 2026-04-13)
  - Exchange account IDs, add Redwood to Acme AWS private-offer allowlist
  - Redwood provides a scoped quote and MAP workbook
  - Security: quick SOC2 summary + answers to your questionnaire (attached)
2) Weeks 1–4 (Pilot / Technical Eval)
  - Access: single-seat API key and dedicated model instance (we'll pin model+quant profile)
  - Eval support: daily syncs days 1, 3, 7 then weekly; workload capture for billing modelling
  - Acceptance criteria: latency SLA, sample downstream quality checks, and cost-per-1k-token baseline
3) Week 5 (Procurement & Legal)
  - Redwood provides PO-ready invoice + private-offer terms for signature
  - Procurement confirms payment method and invoice routing; Redwood provides billing contact and marketplace flow doc
4) Week 6 (Onboard & Billing)
  - Activate private offer, exchange invoice/PO, onboard metering to Acme consolidated bill

Action items for Redwood (we'll own these):
- Deliver MAP workbook (editable)
- SOC2 Q&A + short security checklist
- Quote document for marketplace private offer
- Contact for AWS marketplace activation for Acme's billing team

Ben / Karthik — marking for your input on billing path and any constraints on reserved capacity vs. metered private-offer. Laura — can you slot the MAP workbook link and a draft quote into DocuSign once Ben confirms amounts?

Thanks — happy to run a 30-min kickoff next Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-map-acme-draft.xlsx (workbook with milestone tabs)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sandra Lee <sandra.lee@acmelabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Acme Labs marketplace private-offer evaluation + billing runway

Marissa / Sandra — quick notes on billing options from Redwood's side:

Option A: Marketplace private-offer (recommended for Acme)
- Metered token usage appears on Acme's AWS bill, Redwood invoices monthly to Acme's billing address for overage/commit reconciliation as needed
- No upfront reserved capacity required for pilot; can add reserved pools ahead of production cutover

Option B: Reserved capacity (for predictable throughput)
- Monthly commit + settlement; best for steady production traffic

Practical path for pilot -> PO:
- Pilot runs metered on private offer for 4 weeks (no commit) -> SOW/Quote issued reflecting observed token baseline
- After acceptance, Acme signs private-offer PO for expected baseline + choose reserved capacity level (or keep metered)

Attachments: redwood-quote-ACME-0426.pdf (line item quote; preliminary)

I'll coordinate with our finance ops to include the exact marketplace activation step and required AWS account metadata. Karthik — can you confirm if there are any additional steps for marketplace activation that require infra/engineering (W-forms, SAML mapping, or KMS notes)?

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
